data.name: XuiScene1.XuiEdit1.Text
data.value:
XuiAquatica demonstrates a wide variety of XUI features.
The sample is meant to show a complete UI built on XUI, that has the complexity of a real game UI.
There is extensive demonstration of key frames, animation, custom controls, scene transitions, video playback and 3D rendering.
